contract.reader: An engineering student or engineer with basic electrical knowledge and no background in digital logic or programmable controllers, starting on industrial automation
contract.problem: How the yes-or-no and step-by-step behavior of a machine is specified, simplified and checked before it is programmed on a controller
contract.outcome: Simplify Boolean control logic with identities and Karnaugh maps; assign don't-cares deliberately; build seal-in circuits and latches; use edges, timers and counters and bound their timing error; describe a sequence as a Moore state machine with permissives, interlocks and time-outs
contract.contribution: Digital-logic tools taught through automation cases with the failure-mode reasoning digital-design texts omit, every result checked by a runnable Python program
contract.evidence: Two Python programs with real output; worked Karnaugh maps; Bolton (2015), Cassandras and Lafortune (2008), IEC 60848:2013, IEC 61131-3:2013, Mano and Ciletti (2013), Petruzella (2016)
contract.limitations: Logic and sequence layer only; safety functions to machinery-safety standards explicitly out of scope; single-active-state machines only
